content:
Lean formalisation of Castryck–Cluckers–Dittmann–Nguyen, "The dimension growth conjecture, polynomial in the degree and without logarithmic factors": https://github.com/jasondavies/ccdn-dimension-growth

Formalising the intermediate results turned up a few errors that I couldn't find in the published addenda; none affects the main theorems. I've contacted the authors for their feedback.
